page.layout: One printed page (right) with a running head and page number at the top, one text column in the centre, a narrow column of marginal marks at the right of the text, and a signature and catchword below the text. The left edge of the neighbouring page is not transcribed.

main_text.l: nia): Ingens, inquit, terror astrictus est,
quasi diceretur, Si te non revocat à
cæde hominis, quòd ejusdem tibi naturæ
est, si adeò totus animo sceleratus &
impius es, ut fraternum fœdus violare
veris: cogita, quòd ad imaginem Dei
factus est, & quantis eum Deus dignatus
tus sit: & hæc cogitatio à tam immani
adjicere liceat; si Principis statuam de-
tur, quanto magis diffipans vivum il-

page.notes: The column of marks at the right of the text is thirteen printed «-marks, one beside each of the first thirteen lines; each is shown as a note, but they are placed together at the start of the paragraph rather than beside their exact lines. Doubtful: the printed "ex-ueris" was read as "ex-veris" under the u/v rule. The printer's forms "ipfe", "fator", "fcenam" and "fpectaculum" were corrected to ipse, sator, scenam and spectaculum under the long-s rule. "Vnicum" was read as Unicum, since the initial letter is a vowel. Catchword "eo" and signature "B 2" are at the foot.
